result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a multi-lane roadway featuring marked continental crosswalks and curb ramps. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and parked vehicles near the intersection create visibility and exposure risks.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A white SUV is parked very close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road, just before the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and make pedestrians more visible to approaching traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals within a residential setting. However, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and potential sightline obstructions from mature trees and parked vehicles present risks to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees and parked cars near the corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by traffic lights but lacks visible pedestrian-specific signals to indicate safe crossing times.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve clarity for crossing pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked zebra crosswalks and signal control. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked zebra crosswalk.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and ADA-compliant curb ramps with tactile paving. A large tow truck is currently obstructing the crosswalk, creating a significant physical and visual barrier for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Crosswalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tow truck is stopped within the marked crosswalk, forcing pedestrians to walk around it into the path of traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, blocking the zebra crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The height and bulk of the tow truck prevent drivers and pedestrians from seeing each other clearly at the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Installing bulb-outs would physically prevent large vehicles from stopping in the crosswalk area and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.
